summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Canadian Form 51-102F3 material change report dated November 5, 2026, disclosing board changes effective November 2, 2026. Terrence (Terry) Michael Ryan, a former federal intelligence official and defense/geospatial executive (SAIC/Leidos predecessor, ManTech, Constellis), was appointed an independent director; Philippe Frappier resigned from the board and became a board observer and advisor. No compensation, equity grants, standstill, or transaction terms were disclosed. This is a routine board refresh, not a control event; watch for any strategic shift under the new director.
